scientific_integrity: The infinite-family mod-four congruence and thin-shore sharpness have symbolic combinatorial proofs. The finite K_{4,4} census is supported by two exact exhaustive methods in verify.py and its reproduced 49-level histogram in spectrum.csv.
scientific_limitations: The exact nonunit gap and full signed histogram are established only for K_{4,4}; no exact sharp gap is asserted for K_{m,n} with both shores at least four except K_{4,4}. Historical priority is not independently certified; one related reliability article was available only through its abstract and reference list.
title: Modulo-four Fourier rigidity for bipartite connectivity and its first nonunit recovery gap
